welcome.title: Let Agents Connect Securely
welcome.lede:
Let Grok Bot and Muse in the cloud use Claude Code and Codex on your computer,
and give specialist tasks to specialist agents.
welcome.promise: Even if the server is breached, attackers can’t reach your computer. Sessions are end-to-end encrypted, so the server never sees your content.

browser.title: Complete Sign-In in Your Browser
browser.body: You’ll return here automatically when you’re done. Signing in for the first time creates your account with no password needed.

selfHosted.title: Connect Your Own Server
selfHosted.body: Enter the address of the Hermesh server you deployed, along with the claim code shown when it first started.
selfHosted.plain: Not encrypted (HTTP). Your sessions remain end-to-end encrypted, but the claim code and online machine status travel in plain text. Anyone on the network could read them or claim this server before you do, and Claude and ChatGPT won't be able to connect. This is fine for testing on a trusted network, but add a domain with HTTPS for ongoing use.

authorize.joinNote: After you continue, confirm once with Touch ID, then approve on your existing device.
authorize.joinNote_win: After you continue, confirm once with Windows Hello, then approve on your existing device.
authorize.machineOnlyNote: No Touch ID needed. Just approve on your existing device.
authorize.machineOnlyNote_win: No Windows Hello needed. Just approve on your existing device.
authorize.titleJoin: Add This Mac to Your Hermesh?
authorize.titleJoin_win: Add This PC to Your Hermesh?
authorize.titleTrust: Make This Mac Your Trusted Device?
authorize.titleTrust_win: Make This PC Your Trusted Device?
authorize.body: Hermesh only does what’s listed below. It never changes system settings or reads your files.
authorize.trustedBody: Creates your owner key inside this Mac’s Secure Enclave, where it never leaves the device. Whenever a machine or agent wants to connect, you approve with Touch ID here.
authorize.trustedBody_win: Creates your owner key inside this PC’s security chip (TPM), where it never leaves the device. Whenever a machine or agent wants to connect, you approve with Windows Hello here.
authorize.trustedOff: Off: no owner key is stored here. This Mac only runs tasks, cannot approve requests, and cannot see your other machines. Ideal for a work Mac.
authorize.trustedOff_win: Off: no owner key is stored here. This PC only runs tasks, cannot approve requests, and cannot see your other machines. Ideal for a work PC.
authorize.shareBody: Hermesh runs Claude Code and Codex from the command line just as you do. It never reads API keys or tokens, or touches your agent sign-ins. When turned off, you can still use your other machines and turn this on later in Settings.
authorize.shareBody_win: Hermesh runs Claude Code and Codex from the command line just as you do. It never reads API keys or tokens, or touches your agent sign-ins. When turned off, you can still use your other machines and turn this on later in Settings.
authorize.shareBodyMachine: Hermesh runs Claude Code and Codex from the command line just as you do. It never reads API keys or tokens, or touches your agent sign-ins.
authorize.shareBodyMachine_win: Hermesh runs Claude Code and Codex from the command line just as you do. It never reads API keys or tokens, or touches your agent sign-ins.

authorize.remindBody: Open Hermesh at login in the menu bar and notify me of connection requests, agent questions, and failed sessions.
authorize.remindBody_win: Open Hermesh at login in the notification area and notify me of connection requests, agent questions, and failed sessions.
authorize.remindBodyMachine: Open Hermesh at login in the menu bar and notify me when a session fails.
authorize.remindBodyMachine_win: Open Hermesh at login in the notification area and notify me when a session fails.

unreachable.title: Can’t Reach the Hermesh Server
unreachable.body: This network may be blocking {{host}}, which often happens on corporate networks and proxies. Try another network, such as your phone’s hotspot. Nothing on this Mac has been changed yet.
unreachable.body_win: This network may be blocking {{host}}, which often happens on corporate networks and proxies. Try another network, such as your phone’s hotspot. Nothing on this PC has been changed yet.

removed.title: This Mac Is No Longer in Your Hermesh Account
removed.title_win: This PC Is No Longer in Your Hermesh Account
removed.body: It was removed from another device, or your account was reset. This Mac can no longer approve requests. Set it up again to rejoin your account.
removed.body_win: It was removed from another device, or your account was reset. This PC can no longer approve requests. Set it up again to rejoin your account.
removed.bodyMachine: It was removed from your machines, or your account was reset. It will no longer accept tasks. Set it up again to rejoin your account.

machineOnly.leaveMessage: This Mac will stop accepting tasks immediately, and any running turns will be interrupted. It will also be removed from your machine list (if it’s offline, remove it from a trusted device). Your project folders stay untouched.
machineOnly.leaveMessage_win: This PC will stop accepting tasks immediately, and any running turns will be interrupted. It will also be removed from your machine list (if it’s offline, remove it from a trusted device). Your project folders stay untouched.

connect.promise: Once approved, it receives a signed grant and connects directly to your computer with its own key using end-to-end encryption. The server never sees your content.
